description: Bulk import leads WITH custom fields, duplicate check and a log. PREVIEW BY DEFAULT: nothing is written unless commit=true; preview and commit take the same path and write the same log (list_import_runs). Duplicates: same e-mail = the existing lead (skipped, or with update_existing=true its EMPTY columns are filled and the custom values set — never overwritten); same company domain (from e-mail or website, free-mail ignored) = only a suggestion, not created unless create_domain_matches=true. Bad rows do not stop the run. Accepts rows (array; lead columns like title, first_name, last_name, email, phone, website, city, postal_code, country, category, source, notes … plus custom: { key: value }) or csv (header line; a column named like a custom field key or custom_<key> goes into that field; multiselect values separated by ; or ,). Up to 10000 rows per call.

create_domain_matches.description: Create leads even if only the company domain matches an existing lead.

csv.description: CSV text with header line (alternative to rows)

rows.description: Leads as objects with lead columns plus custom: { key: value }

source.description: Where the rows come from, e.g. 'brevo-2025-12' — appears in the log; also set as the leads' source if the row has none.

update_existing.description: Same e-mail: fill empty columns and set custom values on the existing lead.

name: import_leads
